name: ThumbGenie AI
author: msnisha

sections.description:
ThumbGenie AI uses advanced AI technology to automatically generate beautiful featured images for your WordPress posts based on the post title, excerpt, and content.

Features:

  • One-click featured image generation inside the post editor.
  • Regenerate featured images at any time.
  • View your current subscription usage.
  • Seamless integration into the WordPress admin dashboard.
  • Secure communication with the ThumbGenie AI API.

Why use ThumbGenie AI?
* Save time designing post images.
* Improve your blog’s visual appeal.
* Automatically create images aligned with your content.
* Fully integrated with WordPress standards.

External services

This plugin connects to an API service for generating images using AI. The API call will get blog title and content to
generate more appropriate image the given blog.

This service is provided by ThumbGenieAI.com by Adhithi Ltd: terms of use, privacy policy.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/thumbgenie-ai directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > ThumbGenie AI and enter your API key.
  4. Edit any post, and you’ll see the ThumbGenie AI box in the sidebar to generate featured images!
sections.faq:
Where can I get an API key?

You can sign up and get your API key at ThumbGenieAI.com.

How often can I generate images?

It depends on your subscription plan. Your usage details are shown inside the plugin settings.

Can I regenerate an existing featured image?

Yes! You can click “Regenerate Featured Image” on any post at any time.

Does it work with custom post types?

Currently, ThumbGenie AI only supports the default “Post” type. Support for custom post types will be added in a future version.
